Konami has given F2P players a ridiculous number of quality strikers in eFootball 27 — Aguero, Aubameyang, Luis Suarez, Eto'o, Diouf and Batistuta.
But with so many good FREE CFs available, which one should you actually use?
In this video, I break down each striker, explain their strengths and weaknesses, show the formations they work best in, and reveal how I personally use them in my squad.
I'll also show you which players I recommend as starters and which ones are better used as super subs.
If you're an F2P player and you're confused about which FREE striker deserves a place in your squad, this video is for you.
